_what: 5.4B college-production null — pinned. PRIMARY = pre-registered decision rule + its coherent Westfall-Young family-wise correction (perm_diff exchangeable set). SECONDARY = dom-shuffle joint null under a DIFFERENT exchangeable set (§A3) — a robustness check, NOT the correction for the pre-registered test.

pre_registered._scheme: PRE-REGISTERED (PREREG_5_4B): tertiles FIXED from observed dom_best; permute OUTCOME labels within the top∪bottom pool (MIDDLE THIRD EXCLUDED); per-test independent. add-one p=(1+#{|perm|>=|obs|})/(B+1).
pre_registered.decision_rule: ceiling-target (top5|fwd3_vorp) tertile lift p<0.05 AND directional in >=2 of 3 non-R1 strata (R2,R3,R4-7), ALL-skill

westfall_young_domshuffle_set._scheme: POST-HOC AMENDMENT (§A3): dom-shuffle over the whole stratum (MIDDLE THIRD INCLUDED; tertiles RE-DERIVED), shared across the 24 tests. WY single-step minP. Marginals differ from the pre-registered perm_diff by the exchangeable set (middle-third inclusion), NOT by the coupling.

westfall_young_pre_reg_set._scheme: COHERENT correction FOR the pre-registered test: perm_diff exchangeable set (fixed tertiles, middle EXCLUDED, outcome-label permutation within top∪bottom) COUPLED across the 24 tests by a shared within-stratum key. This is the multiplicity correction for the pre-registered result.
